freshness_policy.rule: Evidence older than 180 days or without an explicit source revision date does not authorize a compatibility PASS. It remains usable as historical evidence only and yields COMPATIBILITY_UNKNOWN until revalidated.
freshness_policy.unknown_rule: Missing, stale, ambiguous, or conflicting marketplace requirements must be represented explicitly and never inferred.

platforms.name: Adobe Stock

facts: Photos: JPEG, minimum 4MP.
Illustrations: JPEG, AI, EPS, or SVG.
Vectors: AI, EPS, or SVG.
Video: MOV or MP4 with H.264.
Video/motion templates: AET, PRPROJ, MOGRT.
Design templates: PSDT, AIT, INDT.
Upload requires metadata and applicable releases.
Vector files must be true editable vectors in AI/EPS/SVG.
Maximum vector file size 45MB.
Adobe can auto-generate JPEG preview and transparent PNG derivative for eligible vectors.
Similar/minimally changed submissions can be treated as spam.

ai_policy_notes: Generative AI content is supported but must follow Adobe generative-AI submission requirements and upload labeling.
unknown_or_conflicting: Per-account SFTP eligibility is conditional and not assumed.

platforms.name: Dreamstime

facts: Dreamstime accepts AI-generated images subject to contributor requirements.
The dated AI guidance states JPEG, PNG, or TIFF technical formats for AI-generated images.
AI submissions require attention to rights, metadata and quality.
Current official contributor page lists JPEG/RGB raster images at least 3MP.
Illustration source formats listed include AI, EPS, CDR and SVG.
QuickTime MOV is preferred for video; WAV or FLAC is listed for audio.

ai_policy_notes: AI-generated content is accepted with disclosure/category requirements and rights obligations.
unknown_or_conflicting: Official Dreamstime pages expose inconsistent raster-format wording: dated 2024 AI guidance mentions JPEG/PNG/TIFF while current contributor FAQ/sell guidance emphasizes JPG/JPEG for standard image upload. Treat PNG/TIFF direct marketplace delivery as COMPATIBILITY_UNKNOWN until a current dated technical page confirms it.
Current contributor technical page lacks an explicit revision date; therefore profile cannot be promoted to current deterministic compatibility.

platforms.name: 123RF

facts: RF photos: JPEG, minimum 6MP, maximum 30MB, minimum 80% quality.
Vector illustrations require matching JPEG and EPS basenames.
JPEG preview minimum stated as 1600x1600 or larger.
EPS should be Illustrator 8 compatible and retain layers.
Web uploader and FTP are documented upload paths.
Current contributor landing page still advertises Photos, Vectors, Video and Audio as supported content families.

unknown_or_conflicting: The detailed official upload specification is dated 2022 and exceeds the 180-day freshness threshold. Exact current pixel/file limits and EPS compatibility version require revalidation before automated packaging PASS.
No current dated official AI-generated-content delivery policy was pinned in this task; AI submission compatibility remains UNKNOWN.

platforms.name: Vecteezy

facts: Vectors: EPS compatible with Illustrator 10, max 50MB, 4MP-25MP, RGB or CMYK.
Photos: JPG/JPEG, sRGB, at least 4MP, max 50MB.
Videos: MP4, MOV, R3D, or MOGRT.
Current contributor page says Vecteezy is accepting photos, vectors and videos.
Current page states JPG/JPEG illustrations and logo templates are not accepted as contributor resources.

unknown_or_conflicting: Detailed technical limits are from a 2021 official checklist and are stale by Factory freshness policy; reconfirm before deterministic marketplace packaging.
Current official contributor page confirms families but does not restate all technical limits.
AI-generated-content eligibility/labeling was not established from a current dated official source in this task and remains UNKNOWN.

platforms.name: MotionElements

facts: Contributor onboarding lists video, music/SFX, photo/vector, 3D, Lottie, presentation, Notion and UI/UX template guides.
Products are uploaded as separate ZIP files or supported URLs, then metadata is completed and the item is published after contributor review.
Upload page supports up to 10 files or folders at one time.
Bulk FTP is available for Video, Music, Photo/Vector and 3D Model according to this dated page.
Generative AI content is accepted under a separate AI-generated contributor account.
AI content must be disclosed as AI-generated and contributors must hold required rights.
AI-generated and traditional content cannot be mixed in the same contributor account under the stated policy.
Stock video duration 3-120 seconds.
Horizontal range 1920x1080 through 3840x2160; vertical range 1080x1920 through 2160x3840.
Accepted frame rates include 24, 25, 29.97, 30, 50, 60 fps or higher.
Each video product is prepared as a separate ZIP; maximum ZIP size 4GB.

ai_policy_notes: AI-generated content requires the separate AI-generated contributor account and explicit AI disclosure.
unknown_or_conflicting: The onboarding page and older bulk-upload page differ on whether 3D Model is FTP-enabled; 3D FTP capability is therefore COMPATIBILITY_UNKNOWN until reconfirmed.
Exact photo/vector technical source-file formats were not pinned from a current dated dedicated guide in this task and remain UNKNOWN for deterministic packaging.
